theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Among the scorable eligible tech themes, Semiconductors (512760.SS) shows the healthiest detector profile: rank 3, eligible, durability_bar 0.5, hurst_tag 'trend' (not mean-revert like the headline AI Compute theme), and crowding_z a benign 0.18. It is the strongest tech proxy with a trend continuation rather than mean-reversion signature, and is not crowded. The lean is directional only because momentum rank carries ~0 forward IC — the 'trend' tag is a coincident texture, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: The headline AI Compute theme is tagged mean-revert, and with zero breadth across the board and a whipsawing Chinese tape (gate_helps false), any tech leadership may reverse hard; semis are high-beta to the same AI trade that is already mean-reverting at the top of the stack.

falsifier.text: 512760.SS closes below its 20-day simple moving average before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Rare Earth & Magnets
theses.thesis: Rare Earth (512400.SS) is eligible at rank 4 with durability_bar 0.52, 'mixed' hurst, and mild crowding (0.64). It sits in the cyclicals/resources cluster alongside Gold Miners (crowded, unscorable) and Industrial Metals (trending, same proxy). Among scorable resource themes it offers resource-policy sensitivity without the crowding flag that sits on Gold or Coal. The lean rests on eligible trend-gate status plus non-crowded positioning; no return claim.
theses.dissent: Momentum rank IC is ~0 and the gate does not hold in this market, so eligibility itself is a weak screen; rare earth is commodity-policy driven and can gap on headline flow (unscheduled_share 0.9), making any directional tilt fragile.

falsifier.text: 512400.SS underperforms CSI 300 by more than 5% before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Brokers & Securities
theses.thesis: Brokers (512880.SS) is ineligible (score -0.32, rank 10), crowded (z 1.01), and mixed-trend. Given the absolute-trend gate did not help on this market's history and crowding is a size-down caution (never a short/fade), the only honest directional expression is to avoid adding exposure to a theme that is both offside on the trend gate and crowded — a reflexive, policy-beta proxy that offers no detector support.
evidence: gate_helps false (no drawdown edge to lean on here)
theses.dissent: Brokers are a policy-call proxy on Chinese risk appetite; if a stimulus/regulatory relief catalyst hits, the crowded ineligible laggard can rally hardest off base despite no detector leg supporting it.

falsifier.text: 512880.SS closes above its 50-day simple moving average before the 30-day check-by date
